title: Chapter 1325 - 9: A New Temporal Lifeform?
content:
Chapter 1325 - 9: A New Temporal Lifeform?

Chapter 1325: Chapter 9: A New Temporal Lifeform?

"Also Xuanhuang, he forcibly broke the cycle, completely perished, and waited to become a time life and be resurrected together, including his Dao companion." Lin Yuan thought far ahead.

Thirteenth-layer life has the ability to resurrect twelfth-layer life. As long as it once existed, it can be ’resurrected’.

...

Lin Yuan continued to observe the time cycle area in the deepest part of the Chaos Void.

The innermost area is basically plunged into complete silence, with no value for observation.

Lin Yuan’s gaze primarily wandered around the outer region, where recent attempts over several eras have tried to impact the perfection of the thirteenth-layer Chaos Realm, getting trapped in the time cycle.

"Hmm?"

"This time cycle region?"

Lin Yuan carefully looked at a certain area, which was even larger than the area occupied by the Moyu Tower Master, obviously also a being with the strength of an Invincible Great Saint in the perfection of the Chaos Realm.

Traces of time power continuously stirred up ripples, indicating that the life inside this time cycle area was fiercely struggling.

"There is hope for breaking through the time cycle."

Lin Yuan nodded slightly; he relied on his own Lord’s position for sensing, resulting in conclusions far more accurate than other time lives.

"The master of this time cycle..."

Lin Yuan followed the causal perception, and the moment he looked at this time cycle, he developed a causal connection with its master.

"Luo Hou Great Saint?"

Lin Yuan murmured to himself.

The moment he mentioned this name, the causal connection deepened, and Lin Yuan immediately began to observe along this Great Saint’s timeline.

Past timeline.

Present timeline.

Future timeline.

"I didn’t expect this Great Saint to have such a causal connection with me?"

Lin Yuan ’saw’ that the Luo Hou Great Saint once ordered two peerless Great Saints to investigate the reason for the deaths of the Nine Phoenix Great Saint and the Shadow Demon Great Saint, and eventually, those two Great Saints investigated all the way to the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

The result was that Lin Yuan casually erased them as an opportunity to establish his prestige.

Later, the name of Lin Yuan as the Invincible Great Saint spread completely.

In the past timeline that Lin Yuan saw, Luo Hou Great Saint, after witnessing Lin Yuan’s strength, was disheartened and gave up on pursuing the title of ’Invincible Great Saint’, directly striving for the thirteenth layer.

"Luo Hou Great Saint has a strong desire for the name of Invincible Great Saint. The thirteenth-layer legacy he cultivated required him to endure endless torture, but he still managed to train it, just because he wanted to become the Invincible Great Saint."

Lin Yuan, through watching Luo Hou Great Saint’s past, clearly understood the other’s obsession.

Even for the sake of achieving that thirteenth-layer legacy, Luo Hou Great Saint lay dormant through several Cosmic Eras, enduring after the last Invincible Great Saint, and eventually succeeded.

It can be said that Luo Hou Great Saint does not hope for crossing into the thirteenth layer, but greatly desires to become the Invincible Great Saint.

"He gave up the obsession to become the Invincible Great Saint, yet it opened a door for him to become a time life?"

Lin Yuan felt quite emotional inside.

Perhaps even Luo Hou Great Saint himself did not perceive this point.

He gave up becoming the Invincible Great Saint entirely because he considered himself not to be Lin Yuan’s match and could not defeat Lin Yuan. Even if he could crush other peerless Great Saints, he still could not become the Invincible Great Saint.

This caused a change in mindset, letting go of what he once wanted, bringing hope to break through the time cycle.

"Obsession?"

Lin Yuan thought to himself, "Obsession greatly affects breaking through the time cycle. Xuanhuang was unable to let go of the obsession to resurrect his Dao companion, and ultimately did not accept the test set by the time cycle."

Luo Hou Great Saint, precisely because he let go of his own obsession, now has hope of breaking through the time cycle, becoming a time life.

The same obsession, two choices, can’t be right or wrong, yet leads to different results.

Of course, what is called obsession only affects the time cycle and is not absolute.

Luo Hou Great Saint’s accumulation is definitely sufficient. This is evident from the fact that the time cycle area he occupies is larger than that of the Moyu Tower Master.

In terms of strength, Luo Hou Great Saint exceeds that of the Demonic Jade Tower Master.

Under the premise of sufficient accumulation, the choice of handling obsession becomes very important.

...

In a certain space within the Chaos Void.

’Lord Mo Xu’ and six thirteen-layer time lives gathered here.

"The Galaxy is becoming increasingly inscrutable."

The tone of the time life wearing black armor was full of wonder. Not only could they not observe Lin Yuan on the time line level, but with the passage of time, Lin Yuan gave them an increasingly terrifying feeling.

"Being inscrutable is the right thing."

The time life with a human head and snake body shook its head and said, "This is definitely a being destined to become a Time Lord. I even feel that it’s part of some layout by a Time Lord, or simply a reincarnation?"

If not a Time Lord himself, why does the future timeline show that he is destined to become a Time Lord?

"Time Lord?"

The expressions of the other time lives turned slightly solemn, and then they questioned with confusion: "But why would a Time Lord be reincarnated into our dimension space?"

Although the Chaos Void is a top dimension space, it’s still not worthy enough for a Time Lord to forsake everything and reincarnate into.

The cost is indeed too great.

"Regardless of whether it’s a reincarnation of a Time Lord, the Galaxy is definitely a time life of our Chaos Void."

’Lord Mo Xu’ glanced at the six time lives and said with a smile: "Being from the same dimension space, our relationship will naturally be very close."

"Right."

"Indeed."

The six time lives nodded successively.

As for Lin Yuan’s background or any layout, just remembering that he’s from the Chaos Void is enough.

An endless number of dimension spaces have given birth to time lives.

And the time lives closest in relation are naturally those that hail from the same dimension space.

Sharing the same homeland inherently makes the relationship closer.

"By the way, how’s the scheme going in the ’Milky Way’ dimension?"

Mo Xu Jun looked at the six time lives.

The ’Milky Way’ dimension is an immense yet chaotic dimension space that does not exclude foreign time lives.

The seven time lives from the Chaos Void entered the Milky Way dimension early, formed alliances there, engaged in games with other time lives, and occupied a large territory.

"Rest assured, the Heart of Heavenly River born this time will surely be ours."

The time life with a human head and snake body said: "Those major powers have all acquired a Heavenly River Heart before, and they won’t intervene to stop us."

The Heart of Heavenly River is a treasure that only appears after countless ages in the Milky Way dimension. Refining it can allow one to directly perceive the operation of the origin rules of the Milky Way dimension.

Time lives are interested in dimension spaces for the unique operation of their origin rules.

Although time lives can slowly perceive the operation of the origin rules once they enter a dimension space, refining a Heart of Heavenly River is a much faster process.

"That will do."

Mo Xu Jun nodded.

With the Heart of Heavenly River, the seven time lives, including himself, can more deeply perceive the essence of the Milky Way dimension’s operation, greatly aiding their own accumulation.

A time life’s lifespan is endlessly long, and accumulating bit by bit, there will inevitably be a day when they approach touching upon becoming a Time Lord.

"Thus, when the Galaxy steps into the thirteenth layer, we’ll have a substantial enough gift to present."

Mo Xu Jun said as he looked at the other six time lives.

The Heart of Heavenly River holds enough allure for time lives, far exceeding the value of the Ten Thousand Meter Nightmare Fruit.

Lord Mo Xu and the other six time lives have been in a game with the time lives of other powers for countless years, ultimately securing this opportunity for perhaps obtaining a Heavenly River Heart this time.

...

Lin Yuan continued to observe the time cycle region in the deepest part of the Chaos Void for a while longer.

Then he withdrew this part of his mind, preparing to continue comprehending the Yin Yang Twin Flowers.

"The third Origin World..."

Lin Yuan’s mind slightly moved, and in the depths of the Myriad Realms Gate, there were coordinates for thirty-three Origin Worlds.

Currently, Lin Yuan has only explored to the second Origin World; there are still thirty-one Origin Worlds left.

The reason for not continuing the exploration is that the subsequent Origin Worlds pose a life-threatening threat to Lin Yuan.

However, now that Lin Yuan is strong enough, he might as well first observe and prepare for how to explore after stepping into the thirteenth layer.

Upon this thought.

Lin Yuan immediately sank his mind into the depths of his mind and looked at the majestic and grand Myriad Realms Gate.
